sections.heading: Barack Obama — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Barack Obama was born on 4 August 1961 in Kapiolani Medical Center for Women and Children, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Barack Hussein Obama II at birth and is publicly known as Barack Obama.

Public records name his father, Barack Obama Sr. and his mother, Stanley Ann Dunham. He is a sibling of Auma Obama, Maya Soetoro-Ng, Bernard Obama, George Hussein Onyango Obama, Mark Okoth Obama Ndesandjo and David Ndesandjo.
He received his education at State Elementary School Menteng 01, Punahou School, Occidental College and Columbia University.
He is recorded as speaking English and Indonesian.

sections.heading: Barack Obama — Career and Professional Work
paras: Barack Obama works primarily as a politician, lawyer, political writer, community organizer, statesperson and jurist, with Business International Corporation, New York Public Interest Research Group and Gamaliel Foundation listed among his employers.
Among the credits most often linked to Barack are A Promised Land.

He has held the following offices: President of the United States (2009–2017), member of the State Senate of Illinois (1997–2004), United States senator (2005–2007), United States senator (2007–2008) and President-elect of the United States (2008–2009). He is affiliated with Democratic Party.
He has taken part in commencement at the Knox College, commencement at the University of Notre Dame and World Government Summit 2016.

sections.heading: Barack Obama — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
